title: Everything waiting on you is on one page, with a pick for each, from every session
why: Sessions work overnight and park questions; you should answer them all in one sitting, not hunt across threads.
note: Deferred part (shiv, Oct 26): the claude-settings build waits on your answer to item 1 of the pilot page. Rulings, Oct 26 (shiv): make "one place to answer everything waiting on me" a standing process, since sessions work overnight; and it must work in all your sessions, every repo, local too. Pilot (thread "Answer all waiting decisions in one place", cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2ADTZhQexksM43HTmuCPZMa): https://claude.ai/artifact/9PJB2skRSMtCC4XHvzbmB8, reading items from its own artifact database (items, answers, meta), so the link never changes; 22 items (17 decisions, 5 hands-on tasks) at roadmap 3409d28, main 54f2dfd. Proposed build, one rule plus one skill in claude-settings: a session that defers an item for you writes it to the page's items collection (id, title, context, options with how, gain and lose, pick, home, owning thread); at its next turn it reads answers/<id>, files the answer in its home and closes the item. Unmeasured: whether a local session can write to a page's database; o10's test clicks (page item 19) measure the nearby case. Overlap: o10's choices 3 and 4 are page items 2 and 3; its choices 1 and 2 become moot if item 1 is (a). Port to other repos: yes, by your widening. Placed ahead of c69 (triage, Oct 26): it unblocks every deferred step at once.
